translation: The middle blood hall (中血堂) is the empty place of the fragile bone below the bridge inside the nose. If injured by a fall or blow, with blood flowing without stopping and the spirit and qi dazed, one should insert Sai Bi Dan (塞鼻丹) into the nose, and externally pour freshly drawn cold water to drench and strike the top of the head. Observe the person: if qi-deficient, internally take Ren Shen Zi Jin Dan (人參紫金丹); if there is blood stasis, take Su Zi Tao Ren Tang (蘇子桃仁湯).
